The '''Barren Frost''' was an area located on the [[Eastern Ice Shelf]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum]], which served as the cite of an [[Imperial base camp]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Ilum]] in the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Barren Frost appears as an area on Ilum in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which contains the main Imperial base on the planet.<ref name="SWTOR" />
